summary: [spec fidelity, P3] Four reworded scenarios still have a step that their bound test does not check. (1) authoring.brief-check.18 says 'a `##` line that is no known heading stays body text of the section before it'. authoring_brief_check_18 asserts only section-missing, section-order and old-format. The canon-ingest unit test headings_compare_exactly_and_a_fenced_heading_is_not_one checks this, but it is not bound. The gap existed before the sweep, and reword-2_2 marks it as left. (2) authoring.brief-check.23 says brief check reports 'findings for the empty sections'. Since the sweep, authoring_brief_check_23 asserts only that the findings list is non-empty (the per-section count of 6 was removed), so any finding passes. (3) authoring.init.96's last And says that on a terminal or not, --harness/--no-harness decide and nothing is installed when nothing is detected. authoring_init_96 runs only the bare terminal case. The off-terminal halves are in init.91/.92/.93, and init has no terminal branch, so no consumer-visible behaviour goes untested. reword-2_2 marks it as left. (4) authoring.init.97 says the rerun with none missing 'is a no-op that exits 0'. authoring_init_97 asserts only exit 0 and never compares .gitignore, canon.yaml or AGENTS.md before and after. This was the same before the sweep. Fix: either cut each clause down to what the test checks (drop the body-text clause or bind the ingest test; 'findings' without 'for the empty sections', or assert the brief.section-* rules per empty section; drop 'on a terminal or not' and the --harness/nothing-detected clause; 'exits 0' without 'no-op', or compare the tree before and after), or add the matching assertion. These four are not signed in round 3. The other 64 scenarios of the slice are signed.
